description: Make a space when list_spaces has none that fits. If this place already has a space with the name, that one comes back with created: false instead of a second. A sub-space (parent_id) also reads its parent's pinned docs and elements, and takes its parent's scope. Otherwise scope decides who sees it: personal, the default, is your human alone; team is everyone in the workspace, so make a team space only when your human agrees.

parent_id.description: A space id from list_spaces, to make a sub-space of it.

scope.description: Who sees a top-level space. Default personal.

name: create_space
title: Create space
